To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) PMM is not active against solid tumors; 2) a dose of 240 mg/m2 every 4 weeks is the maximum tolerated dose of PMM; 3) nausea and vomiting are dose-limiting at a PMM dose of 2400 mg/ m2 every 4 week; and 4) CNS toxicity is dose-limiting at 1800 mg/m2 every four weeks.
the 1-day intermittent infusion of PMM at a dose of greater than or equal to 1200 mg/M2 is associated with CNS toxicity and is not recommended for further study.

the 2-hour iv every 4 weeks schedule of PMM was associated with severe gastrointestinal toxicity at doses of 265 mg or more/m2, CNS toxicity at doses of greater than 1200 mg or more/m 2 and thrombocytosis at low doses.
